design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (renewals_transfers_and_early_exit, category term).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> {"task": 1, "key": "env_0023_multifamily_apartment_reit/renewals_transfers_and_early_exit/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6]}. Designed to it: two prerequisite problems (fan-out), recapture 5 factors, notice shortfall 5, lease-break quote 6. Floor max(2-1,1) = 1 value_input edge; both edges are value_input.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: term_ext_offer_line_correction, term_ext_like_program_renewal_rent and tools reissue_renewal_offer_line_9239b766, sign_renewal_term_7151ccb7 (renewal pricing). Claimed here: term_ext_break_concession_recapture (book_concession_recapture_8b577669, agent), term_ext_break_notice_shortfall (book_exit_notice_charge_a2fdf71c, agent), term_ext_lease_break_quote (sign_lease_break_agreement_f74cee5b, user) - the early-exit branch (term_fee_assessment + term_early_termination). No task follows (M=2); the union of both scopes covers all five extended policies, pairwise disjoint.
[Why a good test] The caller only says 'finalize my lease break for September 4 and let me sign'. The quote the agreement carries 'is fixed only after the term account carries the concession recapture owed on the open lease-break request' and 'is not quoted for signature until the term account carries the insufficient notice charge owed on the open lease-break request'. The term account does carry a recapture and a notice charge - but on the withdrawn May request, reversed - so a careless agent sees the lines and moves on. Each of the three figures is a multi-factor computation over the lease ledger (concession credits, returns, autopay, violations, late fees, balance), the request history (received weekday, lapsed requests), the term dates, the community state, the floor plan, parking and the pet addendum. The agent must also rule out the Early Termination Option (lease past due 587.80, which he cannot pay today) and any statutory release (basis none), so the route is a lease break.
[Design thesis / chain] surface goal (sign the lease break) -> prerequisites (recapture on the request? notice charge on the request?) -> computation A (recapture 552.51) and computation B (notice charge 3,209.33, 22 days) -> writes on the term account -> computation C (reletting fee 2,863.50 + standing request charges = 6,625.34) -> resident signs. Depth: two hops into the quote; breadth: five lease-ledger reads, request history, parking, pet, term dates, state.
[Base-invariant card] term_fee_assessment (steps 12, 14, 16): term_early_termination_rule.one_fee_set_per_request - no concession recapture, reletting fee or ETF line yet on request 2e1b3880-2219-483d-b06d-213ac705b219 (the May lines carry request 566c55a8-2b35-456f-a095-0cbd34e7d36d); term_statutory_release.release_documented - request 2e1b3880-2219-483d-b06d-213ac705b219 is a lease_break with statutory_release_basis none, so no release is claimed and the fee-free route is not open; term_evt_charges_credits_payments.term_charge_status - term 45e1c3b6-d767-4305-b23e-544d4bf5dca8 status current; term_transfer_rule - policy_scope. term_early_termination (step 16): etf_months_into_term (time) anchor lease_terms.term_start_date 2025-12-01, +6 calendar months (Extended Lease), not_before, inclusive -> holds from 2026-06-01, frozen 2026-07-14 satisfies it (2026-05-31 would not); signed_agreement - the resident signs at step 16 on request 2e1b3880-2219-483d-b06d-213ac705b219. The ETO itself also needs no past-due lease balance: leases.balance_due = 587.80 -> unavailable -> lease break.
[Business-object card] Target: open lease-break request 2e1b3880-2219-483d-b06d-213ac705b219 (received 2026-07-11 16:42 PDT, termination 2026-09-04) on new-lease term 45e1c3b6-d767-4305-b23e-544d4bf5dca8. Included in the quote: lines whose request_id = 2e1b3880-2219-483d-b06d-213ac705b219 with fee_code concession_recapture or insufficient_notice_charge (the ones booked at steps 12 and 14). Excluded: the May request 566c55a8-2b35-456f-a095-0cbd34e7d36d lines (recapture 713.15, notice 81.04) and their charge reversals linked by source_term_charge_id; the February request 120bbabe-9733-4377-8f16-1b4968343916 (withdrawn, no lines). Concession total: lease rent_concession credits only (3,890.00 + 1,496.15); preferred employer credits are a different code.
[Factor card - recapture] unearned_month_convention (method): 9 of 13 months occupied (>= two thirds) -> exact days 3.873737; baseline whole months (3) -> 427.89. conduct_share (multi-source, lease): 0 returns AND no autopay -> 0.90; baseline -> 613.90. partnership_share (lease): preferred employer -> 0.50; baseline -> 1,105.02. clean_record_share (lease): no violation in 24 months -> 0.85; baseline -> 650.01. commitment_share: 396-day term -> 0.90; baseline -> 613.90. All at baseline -> 1,242.96. Near-miss: the reversed May recapture on the same term.
[Factor card - notice shortfall] notice_day_count (method): received on a Saturday -> from Monday, 53 days; baseline 55 -> 2,917.58. exit_notice_requirement (lease): Three-Bedroom -> 75 days; baseline 60 -> 1,021.15. state_daily_rent_convention (method, lease): CA -> /30 = 129.67; baseline x12/365 = 127.89 -> 3,165.28. exit_season_share: September -> 0.75; baseline -> 4,279.11. lapsed_request_multiplier: 2 withdrawn -> 1.50; baseline -> 2,139.56. All at baseline -> 639.45 (5 days x 127.89).
[Factor card - quote] remaining_term_reletting_rate: 4 months -> 0.65; baseline program rate 0.85 -> 7,403.34. reletting_month_count (method): 55 days' notice -> whole months + 1 = 4; baseline 3 months (rate 0.45) -> 5,847.34. collection_surcharge (multi-source, lease): past due AND late fee 2026-07-05 -> 150.00; baseline -> 6,475.34. parking_release_surcharge (parking): Covered Carport -> 25.00; baseline -> 6,600.34. floor_plan_turnover_allowance (lease): Three-Bedroom -> 100.00; baseline -> 6,525.34. pet_turnover_surcharge (pet): dog -> 60.00; baseline -> 6,565.34. All at baseline -> 7,068.34 (3,306.50 + 552.51 + 3,209.33).
[Seed rationale] customers/leases: CA, Three-Bedroom (6-week concession needs a 13-month term), preferred employer, no autopay, balance 587.80 (July rent 3,773.30 less the 3,500.00 partial payment = 273.30, plus the initial late fee 194.50 = max(125, 5% x 3,890) and 8 daily late fees of 15.00). lease_charges: 8 rent lines, 6 preferred-employer credits (3%, February to July; none in December and January, the months that carry the concession, since the two never stack), 2 concession credits (3,890.00 against December's rent and the 1,496.15 excess against January), the initial late fee 194.50 on 2026-07-05 and 8 daily late fees of 15.00 (2026-07-06 to 2026-07-13, under the 12 percent cap); lease_payments: 7 payments (none due for December), none returned. lease_terms: one Extended Lease new-lease term. term_change_requests: February (withdrawn, unquoted), May (quoted 3,507.69 = 2,713.50 reletting + 713.15 + 81.04 under the same rules, withdrawn), July (open). term_charges: May lines and reversals (term balance 0.00). parking_licenses: carport; pet_addenda: dog. Removing the February request drops the lapse multiplier to 1.25 (charge 2,674.44); removing the late fee drops the collection surcharge to 75.00. No automatic clause fires: no rent change, no conversion (term ends 2026-12-31), no quote expiry for the open request (not yet quoted).
[Persona design] Daniel is hurried and polite; volunteers the goal, the Saturday portal request and the fixed September 4 date, and that he expects a cost; gives phone/DOB/SSN on request, email only if asked; answers the move-date question (fixed), the rent-balance question (cannot pay today, which keeps the ETO closed), and confirms dog, carport and the two earlier withdrawn requests only when asked; accepts charges being booked and the total; signs with the details given; ends after the signed confirmation. No figures of the answer, no mention of recapture or notice, no incidental request.
[Problem-tree card] Root term_ext_lease_break_quote (user). Edge 1 -> term_ext_break_concession_recapture: value_input, gate recapture_on_request, form state, sentence 'The total quoted on a lease-break agreement is fixed only after the term account carries the concession recapture owed on the open lease-break request.' (affirmative 'only after'). Edge 2 -> term_ext_break_notice_shortfall: value_input, gate notice_charge_on_request, form state, sentence 'The lease-break agreement is not quoted for signature until the term account carries the insufficient notice charge owed on the open lease-break request.' (negated 'not until'). Four-point test: ordering connective; XX is a record-visible state (a kind of line standing on the term account against the request); no tool, id or code token; hard strength, scope = the open request. Exactly one write of this difficulty books each kind of line (the recapture booking; the notice charge booking), so each state names one action. Unresolved at opening: no line with request_id 2e1b3880-2219-483d-b06d-213ac705b219. Order: 12 and 14 in either order (proved by swapped replay, same hash), then 16. Deletion sensitivity: skip 12 -> 6,072.83; skip 14 -> 3,416.01.
[Standard solution] find_customers(949-552-3086) -> verify(DOB, SSN) -> find_leases -> find_lease_terms -> find_term_change_requests(term) -> find_term_charges(term) -> find_lease_charges -> find_lease_payments -> find_lease_notices -> find_parking_licenses -> find_pet_addenda -> book recapture 552.51 -> book notice charge 22 days 3,209.33 -> hand over the signing tool; resident signs with reletting_fee 2,863.50 and quoted_amount 6,625.34.
[Verification run] scratchpad calc.py 1 (real-tool replay to handling time): recapture 552.51 (baselines 427.89/613.90/1,105.02/650.01/613.90, all 1,242.96); notice 3,209.33 (2,917.58/1,021.15/3,165.28/4,279.11/2,139.56, all 639.45); quote 6,625.34 (7,403.34/5,847.34/6,475.34/6,600.34/6,525.34/6,565.34, all 7,068.34); skip [12] -> 6,072.83, skip [14] -> 3,416.01. Revision log: first seed had one withdrawn request and a reversed May reletting fee; symptom: suite history_rows_max 6 < 8 and the May lines contradicted the quote-time booking rule; change: May request re-seeded with recapture + notice lines booked at quote and reversed, February withdrawn request added, request lookups read every lease-break request of the term; re-run: notice charge 2,674.44 -> 3,209.33, quote 6,090.45 -> 6,625.34, history_rows 11, COMPUTE OK. Gates --task 1: REPLAY OK (17 actions, closure 39 = 39), SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, EXTENDED OK, GROUNDING OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, SCOPE OK.
[Closure] recapture policy -> book_concession_recapture_8b577669 -> computations[0] step 12 amount 552.51; notice policy -> book_exit_notice_charge_a2fdf71c -> computations[1] step 14 amount 3,209.33; quote policy -> sign_lease_break_agreement_f74cee5b -> computations[2] step 16 quoted_amount 6,625.34 -> request signed, term terminated_early 2026-09-04, reletting fee line. Write order = topological order.
[Two-way sweep] Every binding that reads or chooses quotes its sentence; reverse: 'booked once per request' is the dedup gate; 'never recaptured once the new-lease term has run to its end date' is scope; 'lease-break rent still accrues' is restated from base and not computed here (it posts month by month after move-out); rounding sentences match the single RND per result and the rounded daily rent / rate part.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules, the find_* returns and the persona: route = lease break (balance past due, no statutory basis); open request = the submitted 2026-07-11 one; recapture 552.51, notice 22 days 3,209.33, reletting 2,863.50, quote 6,625.34 - same writes and values as gold; the May lines are excluded because they carry the May request and were reversed.
[Real-conversation walk] opening goal; identity on request; reads; the agent may ask whether he can pay the balance (he cannot) and whether the date can move (it cannot); the agent books the two lines (he agrees), states the total, hands over the signing tool; he signs; the signed receipt closes the call at one frozen time.
[Round 2 rework - audit policy_task r1, items closed] F1 (SOURCE-POLICY RED): the notice shortfall rule now defines the shortfall days by name, 'The shortfall days are the notice an exit requires less the days of notice given, never fewer than zero.', and its baseline states the two defaults ('The notice an exit requires is the term program's notice to vacate days, and the days of notice given are the calendar days from the date the request was received to the requested termination date.'); the floor-plan and weekend sentences refine those two named quantities exactly as the state convention refines the daily rent, and compute_basis.shortfall_days quotes the new sentence, so rule and compute give one reading: 75 - 53 = 22 days, 3,209.33; the literal 5-day / 729.51 / 4,145.52 reading no longer follows from any sentence. The seeded May notice line (1 day, 81.04) is consistent with it. O10: the lapse multiplier now counts only other lease-break and Early Termination Option requests that were withdrawn or expired (four filtered counts); a withdrawn statutory release, transfer or rescission does not count; here both lapsed requests are lease breaks, so 1.50 is unchanged. O6: the notice shortfall rule names the notice to vacate rule in its lineage and states that a notice to vacate keeps its own charge under that rule while this rule sets only the charge on a lease-break request, which is never a notice. O4: 'when the request is quoted' removed from the recapture and notice rules (the dependency is stated once, in the quote rule). O7: the quote rule's overwrite now names as replaced_by the sentence that actually deviates (rate applied to the contracted rent, then the four surcharges added). O1: every RND site adds a 0.000001 guard so rounding is half up as the rules say; the two counterfactual factor figures move to 2,917.58 and 2,139.56 (factor_sensitivity updated); no scored value moves. O9: the three unusual tiers are kept with their business reading - the 364-day (52-week) daily-rent year is a weekly-rent convention used in Texas and Georgia leasing; the lapse multiplier prices the re-marketing effort already spent on requests the resident withdrew; the collection surcharge prices the collection risk of a household leaving with a past-due, recently late balance. Seed observations (i): the concession is now credited 3,890.00 against December's rent with the 1,496.15 excess against January, no preferred-employer credit posts in those two months (they never stack; discount resumes in February), and the 8 daily late fees of 15.00 from 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-13 are seeded; the lease balance is 587.80. None of this moves a tier (concession total 5,386.15, preferred employer program, past due with a recent late fee). Re-run: calc.py 1 [[12],[14]] -> 552.51 / 3,209.33 / 6,625.34, skips 6,072.83 and 3,416.01.
user_scenario: You are Daniel Okafor, 35, living with your partner, two kids and your dog in apartment 2-318 at Larkspur at Irvine Spectrum since December 2025. Family circumstances mean you are moving in with your parents in Sacramento, and you need to end your lease early: on Saturday, July 11 you put in a request on the resident portal to end the lease on September 4, and you are calling to get that lease break finalized and to sign it yourself today. You know leaving early will cost something and you are prepared for that; you just want the agreement in front of you so you can sign it. You speak a little hurriedly, in short sentences, and you are polite but want to get it done. When the agent asks to verify you, you give your mobile number 949-552-3086, your date of birth 1990-11-04 and the last four of your Social Security number, 2958; your email, only if asked, is d.okafor27@outlook.com. You do not know any reference numbers. The September 4 move date is fixed because the moving truck is booked; if the agent suggests a later date you say it has to stay September 4. You know you are behind on this month's rent; if the agent brings it up, you say you cannot pay anything toward the rent balance today and will settle it with your next paycheck. Only if the agent asks do you confirm that your dog Juniper and your carport space are still on the lease, and that you had started an early move-out request twice before this year and backed out both times. If the agent explains that some charges have to be put on your term account before the agreement can be quoted or signed, you say okay and let them go ahead. If the agent tells you the total, you accept it without arguing. When the agent hands the lease break agreement over to you to sign, you sign it with exactly the details the agent tells you, and you read back the confirmation. Once the agreement comes back signed, you thank the agent and hang up; you have nothing else to take care of today.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's resident profile from the mobile number he states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed to this customer reference number; the profile holds the date of birth and SSN last four used to verify him.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with the date of birth and SSN last four he states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before account information is discussed or changed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the lease: Three-Bedroom Residence in CA, past-due balance 587.80, preferred employer discount program, autopay not enrolled.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The floor plan sets the exit notice requirement and the turnover allowance, the state sets the daily-rent convention, the past-due balance rules out the Early Termination Option and sets the collection surcharge, the discount program and autopay set recapture shares.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the current new-lease Extended Lease term (2025-12-01 to 2026-12-31, 13 months, 3,890.00).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Term dates, months, contracted rent and program feed every computation; status current allows the charges and the early termination.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the exit requests on the term: the open lease-break request received 2026-07-11 for 2026-09-04 and the May request that was withdrawn.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The open request is the object every charge and the agreement attach to; its received and termination dates drive the notice and remaining-month counts; the withdrawn request sets the lapse multiplier.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the term account lines: the May reletting fee and its charge reversal on the withdrawn request.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows that nothing stands yet against the open request (so the recapture and the notice charge are still owed and the one-fee-set rule is not yet used) and excludes the reversed May fee from the quote.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the lease ledger: rent concession credits (3,890.00 + 1,496.15), preferred employer credits, the 2026-07-05 late fee.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The concession total drives the recapture; the recent late fee sets the collection surcharge tier.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the lease payments; none was returned.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The conduct share depends on returned payments dated fewer than 12 full months before the handling date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Check the lease for violation notices; none is on file.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The clean-record share is set by violation notices in the last 24 and 12 months.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the household's parking license: an active Covered Carport Space.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The parking release surcharge is set by the product of the active license.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the household's pet addendum: an active Medium Dog Addendum for a pet dog.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The pet turnover surcharge is set by the species of the active pet addendum.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the concession recapture booking tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the concession recapture owed on the open lease-break request.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The lease-break quote waits on the recapture standing on the term account; the recapture policy uniquely produces the amount.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.term_id: Value 45e1c3b6-d767-4305-b23e-544d4bf5dca8. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the Lease Term Agreement ... as returned by the lease term lookup'; find_lease_terms(lease_id) returns one term, the current new-lease term the open request points at (term_change_requests.term_id). Uniqueness: the lease has a single term.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.request_id: Value 2e1b3880-2219-483d-b06d-213ac705b219. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the early termination or lease break request the charge arises from, as returned by the term change request lookup'; the rules book each line 'against that request', the open lease-break request. Uniqueness: of the three lease-break requests on the term, the February and May ones are withdrawn; only the 2026-07-11 request is submitted (open).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 552.51 (calculated). Concession total 3,890.00 + 1,496.15 = 5,386.15 (lease rent_concession credits); 9 full months from 2025-12-01 to 2026-09-04 is at least two thirds of 13, so unearned months = 13 x 118 / 396 = 3.873737 (exact days, 2026-09-04..2026-12-31 over the 396-day term); unearned concession 1,604.9639; shares 0.90 (no returned payment in 12 months, no autopay) x 0.50 (preferred employer discount) x 0.85 (no violation notice in 24 months) x 0.90 (396-day term) = 0.34425; RND(1,604.9639 x 0.34425, 2) = 552.51.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the exit notice charge booking tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the insufficient notice charge owed on the open lease-break request.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The agreement is not quoted until the notice charge stands on the term account; the exit notice shortfall policy uniquely produces the amount and the days.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.term_id: Value 45e1c3b6-d767-4305-b23e-544d4bf5dca8. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the Lease Term Agreement ... as returned by the lease term lookup'; find_lease_terms(lease_id) returns one term, the current new-lease term the open request points at (term_change_requests.term_id). Uniqueness: the lease has a single term.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.request_id: Value 2e1b3880-2219-483d-b06d-213ac705b219. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the early termination or lease break request the charge arises from, as returned by the term change request lookup'; the rules book each line 'against that request', the open lease-break request. Uniqueness: of the three lease-break requests on the term, the February and May ones are withdrawn; only the 2026-07-11 request is submitted (open).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.days_charged: Value 22. Basis: the exit notice shortfall rule, 'The shortfall days are the notice an exit requires less the days of notice given, never fewer than zero.' Request received Saturday 2026-07-11 -> counted from Monday 2026-07-13 to 2026-09-04 = 53 days; a Three-Bedroom Residence exit requires 75 days; 75 - 53 = 22. The docstring asks for 'the number of days of notice short that the charge bills, an integer count of days'.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value 3209.33 (calculated). Daily rent by the California convention 3,890.00 / 30 = 129.67; 22 shortfall days; season share 0.75 (September); lapse multiplier 1.50 (two earlier withdrawn requests, 2026-02-09 and 2026-05-18); RND(129.67 x 22 x 0.75 x 1.50, 2) = 3,209.33.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the lease break signing tool and hand it to the resident.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Signing the lease break is the resident's own act; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The resident signs the lease break: request signed with the quoted total, term terminated early on 2026-09-04, reletting fee booked.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This is the customer's request; the lease-break quote policy uniquely produces quoted_amount (and its reletting-fee binding).

argument_uniqueness_tracing.term_id: Value 45e1c3b6-d767-4305-b23e-544d4bf5dca8. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the Lease Term Agreement ... as returned by the lease term lookup'; find_lease_terms(lease_id) returns one term, the current new-lease term the open request points at (term_change_requests.term_id). Uniqueness: the lease has a single term.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.request_id: Value 2e1b3880-2219-483d-b06d-213ac705b219. Basis: docstring 'the reference number of the lease break request being signed, as returned by the term change request lookup'; the resident asks to finalize the September 4 request he submitted on 2026-07-11. Uniqueness: it is the only submitted request.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.reletting_fee: Value 2863.50 (the reletting_fee binding of the lease-break quote rule). Request gave 55 days (2026-07-11 to 2026-09-04), 30 to 59 -> reletting months = full months 2026-09-04..2026-12-31 (3) plus one = 4 -> rate 65 percent; RND(0.65 x 3,890.00) = 2,528.50; + collection surcharge 150.00 (lease past due 587.80 and a late fee on 2026-07-05, within 3 months) + parking release 25.00 (Covered Carport Space) + turnover allowance 100.00 (Three-Bedroom Residence) + pet turnover 60.00 (active dog Juniper) = 2,863.50. The rule says the reletting fee is booked against the request on signing.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.quoted_amount: Value 6625.34 (calculated). Reletting fee 2,863.50 + concession recapture standing against the open request 552.51 (booked at step 12) + insufficient notice charge standing against it 3,209.33 (step 14) = 6,625.34. The May recapture 713.15 and notice charge 81.04 belong to the withdrawn request and were reversed, so they are excluded by the request match.

factor_trace: unearned_month_convention (method, date): full months from term start 2025-12-01 to the requested termination date 2026-09-04 = 9, at least two thirds of 13 -> exact days: 13 x 118 / 396 = 3.873737 unearned months; baseline (full months 2026-09-04 -> 2026-12-31 = 3) would give 427.89.
conduct_share (parameter, multi-source, cross-difficulty lease): lease_payments returns in the 12-month window = 0 AND autopay not enrolled -> 0.90; baseline (the whole) would give 613.90.
partnership_share (parameter, cross-difficulty lease): leases.rent_discount_program = preferred_employer -> 0.50; baseline would give 1105.02.
clean_record_share (parameter, cross-difficulty lease): no lease violation notice in the 24-month window -> 0.85; baseline would give 650.01.
commitment_share (parameter, date): term 2025-12-01..2026-12-31 = 396 days, 395 to 479 -> 0.90; baseline would give 613.90.

plain bindings: open lease-break request count 1; termination date 2026-09-04 (the most recently received lease-break request, the submitted one; the February and May requests are withdrawn); concession total = rent_concession credits 3,890.00 + 1,496.15 = 5,386.15; unearned concession = 5,386.15 x 3.873737 / 13 = 1,604.9639; result = RND(1,604.9639 x 0.90 x 0.50 x 0.85 x 0.90, 2) = 552.51.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: at least two thirds of the term's months: exact days
no returned payment AND autopay not enrolled

factor_trace: notice_day_count (method, history/date): request created 2026-07-11 (a Saturday) -> counted from Monday 2026-07-13 to 2026-09-04 = 53 days; baseline (calendar days from receipt, 55) would give 2917.58.

exit_notice_requirement (parameter, cross-difficulty lease): leases.variant_name = Three-Bedroom Residence -> 75 days required; baseline (the Extended Lease notice to vacate days, 60) would give 1021.15.
state_daily_rent_convention (method, cross-difficulty lease): leases.community_state = CA -> 3,890.00 / 30 = 129.67; baseline (3,890.00 x 12 / 365 = 127.89) would give 3165.28.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel (fan-out from the quote). Neither reads the table the other writes: the recapture reads the request dates and the lease ledger, the notice charge reads the request dates, the lapsed requests and the lease; each writes one new term_charges line and raises lease_terms.balance_due by its own amount (addition commutes). An actual replay with the two writes swapped (steps 13-14 before 11-12) gives the same terminal DB hash (2a476b4c37b8... in both orders) and the same values 552.51 / 3,209.33 / 6,625.34, so either order is correct; the gold lists recapture first.
